name: Can natural stone flooring be installed in bathrooms or kitchens?

mainEntity.name: Can natural stone flooring be installed in bathrooms or kitchens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, natural stone flooring can be installed in bathrooms and kitchens. These areas are popular choices due to the stone's aesthetic appeal and durability. However, it's essential to select appropriate stone types and ensure proper sealing, especially in wet environments like bathrooms, to prevent water penetration and staining. Textured or honed finishes can offer better slip resistance in these areas compared to polished surfaces. Professional installation ensures proper waterproofing and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, natural stone is suitable for bathrooms and kitchens, but requires proper sealing and consideration for slip resistance.
